title: Visibility
description: No more hiding in the shadows! Visibility adds a new potion and status effect that instantly dispels invisibility from any player or entity it touches.
body:
Tired of sneaky players in PvP or invisible spiders ruining your hardcore run? Visibility is the definitive counter-measure for anyone who wants to stay one step ahead of the unseen.

This lightweight mod introduces the Visibility status effect, designed specifically to negate and automatically remove the Invisibility effect from any target. Whether you're defending your base or hunting down cloaked enemies, the truth is now just one potion away.

🌟 Features:

The Visibility Effect: A custom status effect that, when active, continuously checks for and removes the Invisibility effect from the entity.

Alchemical Counter: Fully integrated into the brewing system.

Universal Detection: Works on players, passive mobs, and hostile entities alike.

🧪 Alchemy (Brewing Recipe):

Base: Awkward Potion

Modifier: Glow Squid Ink Sac

Result: Potion of Visibility

(Tip: Brew it into a Splash Potion to reveal hidden enemies from a distance!)

✨ Planned Features:

Visibility Charms: Rare items that grant permanent detection in a small radius.
